title: Snazzie FM News: The Blotter Hour
description: Dale Crisp and Marsha Veld read the overnight crime blotter, completely deadpan: a stolen bike lane that left a thank-you note, a clinic burglary where nothing was taken, and a developing situation with the downtown fog.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: It's the top of the hour. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Tonight, the Blotter Hour. Dale.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Overnight, the entire eastbound bike lane was reported stolen. Police say the suspect left a forwarding address... and a thank-you note.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Polite. Over on Third, the HonkHeal clinic was burgled. Nothing was taken.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: The intruder simply honked at the front desk for six hours, and left healed.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And the developing thread. The downtown fog, last seen attempting to pay first and last month's rent, is now a person of interest in three break-ins.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Police keep noting it remains, quote, cooperative... and out front.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Still no word from the fog. <p:0.3> And finally, Dale.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: <p:0.3> The fog turned itself in this afternoon. It confessed to all three burglaries, posted bail in exact change, and asked if the holding cell was available on a twelve-month lease.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Detectives say it filled out the paperwork beautifully.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We'll have more as the fog settles. For Snazzie FM News, I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Good night.
